breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the principal stress formula using the full plane stress state (σx, σy, τxy), computing principal stresses via the standard formula σ1,2 = (σx + σy)/2 ± √[((σx - σy)/2)² + τxy²]. It does not treat the original x–y axes as principal directions despite the presence of nonzero shear stress. The results (σ1 = 7.61 MPa, σ2 = -0.94 MPa) properly account for the shear stress contribution, matching the ground truth approach.
